plainText:
Misty's Azurill (Japanese: カスミのルリリ Kasumi's Ruriri) was a acquired by in the Kanto region, and her eleventh overall.

==History==
=== ===
 
Azurill is the child of Tracey's Marill, though it is unknown which Pokémon was the other parent. Misty mentioned that gave it to her when it was just an .

Azurill debuted in The Scheme Team, when and arrived in Pallet Town to embark on Ash's to challenge the .

In The Right Place and the Right Mime, Azurill paired up with Tracey's Marill to fight off 's attack on Professor Oak's Laboratory.

Later, Azurill accompanied Misty while she was on her way back to the Cerulean Gym, with the group accompanying them on their way to the . In A Real Cleffa-Hanger, Team Rocket attacked the group as they picnicked at the foot of Mt. Moon. Azurill, notably, befriended a who had become separated from its family. The group eventually foiled another Team Rocket scheme and helped the Cleffa reunite with its family. Afterwards, Misty and Azurill left Ash and the others and returned to the Cerulean Gym.

=== ===
Azurill reappeared in A Fated Face-Off!. During the episode, it reunited with Ash and watched as he and its Trainer battled over a wild . After Misty won the battle and caught , it celebrated with her and .

==Personality and characteristics==
 
 
Despite being small, Azurill is already powerful, assisting in the effort to fend off in The Right Place and the Right Mime. Much like before it, Azurill is usually held in Misty's arms.

As a baby Pokémon, Azurill is very playful, as seen when it was playing with a , using its ball-like tail to entertain the . It is also very sociable, helpful, and friendly towards other Pokémon, as seen when it healed from his injuries by using Refresh.
 

==Moves used==
 
 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
Azurill is the only one of 's :
That she currently owns to not be a type.
To not be weak to moves.
Azurill is the only Pokémon hatched from an in the to have a confirmed relation with a main character's Pokémon.
Azurill is the first Pokémon hatched be a main character to have never been seen as an Egg.
Azurill was seen using more moves than its parent.
Azurill has the lowest base stat total of any Pokémon owned by a main character.
